document_summary: Berkeley Rent Board web page summarizing California security deposit law (AB 12 caps, photographs, return and deductions) and Berkeley's security deposit interest requirement under the Rent Ordinance.

rules.title: California security deposit cap (AB 12)
rules.requirement: Landlords may generally charge a security deposit of no more than one month's rent for furnished and unfurnished units; certain small landlords may charge up to two months' rent. Deposits must be returned within 21 days after move-out with an itemized statement, and photographs of the unit are required at move-in and after move-out.
rules.key_value: 1 month's rent (up to 2 months' rent for qualifying small landlords)
rules.coverage_conditions: The two-month cap applies to landlords who own only two rental properties with no more than four residential units total, where ownership is held by a natural person, family trust, or LLC in which all members are natural persons. Last month's rent counts as part of the deposit; first month's rent does not.
rules.interaction: State floor applied in Berkeley; Berkeley adds a separate security deposit interest requirement for units covered by its Rent Ordinance.
rules.citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 (as amended by AB 12)
rules.quoted_span: Starting July 1, 2024, many landlords may only charge one month's rent for unfurnished and furnished units
rules.extraction_notes: Secondary summary by Berkeley Rent Board of state law. Before July 1, 2024 the cap was two months' rent (unfurnished) and three months' (furnished). Photograph duties: move-in for tenancies beginning on or after 2025-07-01; post-move-out photos from 2025-04-01; proof of repairs from 2025-01-01. Return deadline 21 days. The Rent Board says it cannot determine whether a landlord may charge one or two months' rent.  Effective date 2024-07-01 per the page's 'Starting July 1, 2024'.

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords of units fully or partially covered by the Berkeley Rent Ordinance must pay tenants interest on security deposits at the end of each year, and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before year end.
rules.key_value: Annual interest on the security deposit, paid at end of each year (prorated on move-out)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance.
rules.interaction: Supplements the California deposit cap and return rules (Civ. Code § 1950.5), which also apply in Berkeley.
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.76 (Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Good Cause Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: For tenancies in units fully or partially covered by Berkeley's Rent Ordinance, landlords must pay tenants interest on their security deposit at the end of each year and a prorated amount if the tenant moves out before the end of the year.
rules.extraction_notes: Interest rate is not given in this page (refers to a separate Security Deposit Interest & Calculator page). Effective date not stated, so null. The specific BMC section is not cited in the source; chapter cite is the best reading.
